supporting_pages.title: "Access control and permission management \_|\_ Looker \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Folders let you set access levels that determine which users may edit folder contents (such as Looks and dashboards), view the contents in a folder, and change settings: A user needs to have at least the View access level to a folder to see that the folder exists, to view the Looks and dashboards inside it, and to copy the Looks and dashboards in the folder.

A user needs to have the Manage Access, Edit access level for a folder to manage access to the folder and to edit the folder and its content (including renaming folders, moving content, and deleting Looks and dashboards).
Feature Access , which controls the types of actions a user is allowed to do in Looker, including viewing data and saved content, changing the LookML models, administrating Looker and so forth.
